title: Aurora Watch
text:
🌌 Aurora Watch — September 24, 2026

Near-Earth conditions are starting to line up: elevated Kp and southward Bz. Sunny is keeping watch.

🌎 Kp: 4.33 (elevated)
🧲 IMF Bz: -5.8 nT (southward)
💨 Solar wind: 386 km/s (Moderate)
🚨 NOAA: ALERT: Geomagnetic K-index of 4
☀️ Solar driver context: CH-HSS

I'm watching this one. 👀

Aurora visibility still depends on location, darkness, cloud cover, and how the magnetic field evolves from here. ✨

Image: NOAA SWPC — OVATION Aurora Forecast
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
